prompt: Generate a high fidelity desktop web app UI mockup for Climbing Club Dashboard, landscape, edge-to-edge screen without device or browser surround. The club treasurer works offline collecting gas receipts, reviewing extracted total cost and price per gallon, then exporting a printable reimbursement PDF. Dark theme with midnight navy shell, slate working surfaces, legible white and muted blue-gray text, exact brand accent #4B9CD3 on selections and primary actions; dark ink text on blue buttons. Clean humanist sans typography, precise tabular currency, no decorative charts or climbing artwork. Standard familiar app controls. Example data is explicitly labeled Illustrative trip. Example trip: Fall climbing trip, Oct 30–Nov 1 2026, New River Gorge; 3 drivers. Alex Morgan has gas receipt 1 $42.50 at $3.459/gal and receipt 2 $38.25 at $3.399/gal, subtotal $80.75, Zelle. Other drivers Jamie Chen $56.20 CashApp, Sam Rivera $49.10 Check. One receipt needs review. Header includes trip name, dates and location; navigation Trips, Profile, Storage. Each receipt belongs to a driver. PDF has no images. No invented official club branding. Driver-first composition: persistent compact left navigation, central wide table with expandable driver groups and receipt rows, selected receipt's original image and editable amount/price-per-gallon in a right review pane. Lead with the driver list, not huge metrics. Header actions Add receipts and Preview PDF; review status and driver totals readable at once. One meaningful signature detail is a repeated aligned column of driver subtotals. Show footer offline storage status. Render the whole screen with generous usable space and crisp readable text.
